es.purpose: Confirmar tu asistencia a eventos, sumarte a desafíos y aparecer en las listas de participantes.
es.scope: Guardamos tus RSVPs, asistencia confirmada y capturas de registro presencial en eventos.
es.retention: El historial de eventos se guarda mientras tengas cuenta. Lo eliminamos en 72h si borras tu cuenta.
es.share: Los organizadores ven la lista de confirmados. Nunca compartimos tu asistencia con marcas sin tu permiso.

en.purpose: Confirm your attendance at events, join challenges and appear on participant lists.
en.scope: We store your RSVPs, confirmed attendance and walk-in records at in-person events.
en.retention: Event history is kept while you have an account. We delete it within 72h if you delete your account.
en.share: Organizers see the confirmed list. We never share your attendance with brands without your consent.
